description: Delete an Azure ExpressRoute connector in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A connector used by segment resources, NAT policies or other objects is refused as in use. The backend removes the connector's implicit group, named after the connector, with it, and releases its vhubPrefix when no other ExpressRoute connector on the CXP uses it. If it is deployed, the delete only marks it for deletion: it keeps carrying traffic, with its name, until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the Azure ExpressRoute connector, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The connector_azure_express_route_get_* read tools and connector_azure_express_route_create return it.

name: connector_azure_express_route_delete
